messages:
devon: Quick heads-up — PR #8621 ready for review but blocked by architecture sign-off. I couldn't find the RFC link in the PR description. Can someone point me to the doc or confirm merge gate? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8621
kevin: I don't see an RFC either. We need the RFC link + a short SLO/cost delta before any merge. Also: confirm fallback behavior when the new routing path is saturated.
maria: sorry, that was my bad — I drafted the RFC but didn't attach. RFC ID is rfc-247 (network-routing/fallback). Google doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcXYZ_rfc247
maria: short summary: this change adds a routing priority shim that prefers fast-path GPUs; fallback to variant-b when capacity low; expected 95th p99 latency +5ms; token-cost +0.8%.
kevin: thanks. Can you paste the canary plan here and add the RFC link to the PR description? Need to know canary window & rollback criteria.
maria: canary plan:```canary: 5% traffic, 24h window, metric-checks: p99 lat, error-rate, model-variant-mismatch; rollback if error-rate > 0.5% OR p99 delta > 15ms for 3 consecutive mins```
natalie: timeline check — if arch approves today we can slot the canary in tomorrow morning (EMEA-friendly). Who owns monitoring alerts?
devon: @eng-sre will be on alert; I'll ping them once arch gives the green.
kevin: @maria please add the RFC link + the canary snippet to the PR body and add a short SLO delta line (numeric). Also include the fallback matrix for compatible model variants. After that I can do an architecture quick review.
maria: will update PR in 10m and add tests for fallback.
arch-bot: RFC rfc-247 status: review_requested (1 unresolved question: clarify shard-affinity impact on cold-starts). See https://rfc-system/internal/rfc-247
kevin: noted — I'll take a look at shard-affinity question. If that looks OK and SRE signs off on alerts, I'll drop an approval. @maria add a note that SRE knows the alert thresholds.
devon: perfect. tagging this thread — merge blocked until RFC link + SLO numbers + SRE ack. Thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: actionable checklist: add RFC link (maria), add SLO delta (maria), SRE ack (devon to confirm), arch quick review (kevin). Once done I'll approve.
maria: done — PR updated with RFC link, canary plan, SLO delta (+0.8% cost, p99 +5ms). pinging @devon for SRE ack.
devon: SRE confirmed alerting config and on-call coverage for the canary window. We can proceed to canary once kevin approves.
kevin: reviewing now, will post any small comments. If nothing major, I'll approve and mark for canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
kevin: approves (pending tiny nits fixed). marking thread resolved from arch side.
mar ia: thanks! will address nits and merge on canary start.
